# <span id="aanchor183"></span> Toolbox

The Toolbox comprises a set of tools that can be used to perform various tasks from applying analysis to performing data validations on demand.

Some Toolbox operations are not intended for use on closed data. If attempted, FLOWCAL will display a message stating that an operation is not allowed on closed data.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Toolbox screen: 

Go to **Tools** \> **Toolbox**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 484;height: 415;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" /> Toolbox Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available on the Toolbox screen:

- **Date Type** - Select a span of time, such as contract month, contract day(s), or date/time range.

- **Recalc Rollup IDs** - This function should only be run at the request of Customer Support.

- **Run Validations** - Run the configured validations for meters, locations and/or sources, for the selected time frame. The objects validated depend on the selected object type as follows:

- **Apply Defined Auto Edits** - Apply auto edits that are assigned to a meter.

- **Apply This Auto Edit** - Apply the auto edit selected from the drop-down list. You may also apply multiple auto edits.

- **Force Recalc of** - Force a recalculation of the volume or VCF due to edits that did not trigger a recalculation.

- **Accept Auto Estimates** - Accept auto estimated data to allow the assigned source analysis to be applied.

- **Apply Source Analysis to Meters** - Apply source analysis to a single meter or multiple meters based on the source assignment.

- **Load Source Analysis from Meter** - Push an analysis from a meter to a source.

- **Run Duration Fix Utility** - Normally run under the suggestion of your Customer Support representative when an abnormal situation may point to possible gaps or overlaps in characteristic and analysis data. This utility addresses situations that cannot be fixed or addressed by normal data processing or editing in FLOWCAL, and addresses issues in the revision zero records and the latest or current revision records. (See: [Duration Fix Utility](Run%20Duration%20Fix%20Utility.md))

- **Calculate FMP Tier** - Recalculate the FMP volume tier. This only applies to meters for which the BLM Property designation is set to "Yes". (See: [FMP Tier Calculation](../../BLM/FMP%20Tier%20Calculation.md))

- **Queue Live Oil Child Meters** - Queue to send data from a live oil meter to any associated dead oil or flash gas child meters. (See: [Live Oil Management](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Tools%20Menu.md))

  This only applies to meters that are designated as live oil and have an active relationship to at least one child meter.
